# DuckDB v1.5.5

The bundled Windows x64 library and headers identify DuckDB v1.5.5,
source ID `d8cdaa33fd`. DuckDB uses the MIT license in `LICENSE`.

MARK links the supplied DLL and import library. The headers and library files
are sufficient to compile MARK; the DuckDB source tree is not required.
Official source URLs and version checksums are recorded in `SOURCE_ORIGIN.json`.
To rebuild DuckDB, obtain that version from the official DuckDB repository and
follow its Windows build instructions. Replace the DLL and import library as
a matching x64 Release pair and retain the upstream license notices.
